The '''Myr Rho''' was a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]], notable because they appeared to be less catlike than the baseline Cathar [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Planet Hoppers: Cathar">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/PHCathar|series=Planet Hoppers|text=Cathar}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Myr Rho share a name with the Cathar individual [[Myhr Rho]]. Myhr Rho appeared in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''. He was later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] into a Cathar by his [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry, which explained that his appearance differed from previously seen Cathar such as [[Crado]] and [[Sylvar]] because he shaved off his fur to accommodate the hot [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] climate.<ref name="DB-Rho, Myhr">{{DB|character|myhrrho|Rho, Myhr}}</ref> If Myhr Rho is intended to belong to the Myr Rho subspecies, then [[Planet Hoppers]] article appears to be altering the above retcon.
